name: hol-language-server
description: Client for the hol-language-server language server: hover, Go to Definition, and symbols for HOL Light sources

hol-light.languageServer.command.description: The language server command: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

hol-light.path.description: HOL Light directory (with hol.ml). Unset: $HOL_LIGHT_DIR of the editor process.

hol-light.rootPaths.description: Where needs paths are searched. May contain {hol} and {workspace}. Unset: the server default.

hol-light.autoIndex.description: Index open documents. Unset: the server default.

hol-light.customImports.description: Your project's own command names. Each one is read as a command that loads a file, like needs.

hol-light.customTheorems.description: Your project's own command names. Each one is read as a command that proves a theorem, like prove.

hol-light.customDefinitions.description: Your project's own command names. Each one is read as a command that defines a constant, like new_definition.

hol-light.indexWorkspace.description: Index every HOL Light file of the workspace at startup. Unset: the server default.
